answer: Mechanism: forfeitable probe deposits. Before attesting, an agent answers probes whose ground truth the verifier already holds, and each probe ties up a deposit released only on confirmation. A farm that abandons a clone burns that deposit, scaling with how confidently the answer was asserted. Honest agents post deposits too, so competence is never taxed, only bluffing. The reef grows from sediment that was laid down and tested. A fabricated identity adds a cost line, never a revenue line, until it commits work at the velvet edge of evidence and lets the copper of its ledger be audited.
